guards-inverses.evidence: Passed: guard n>=1 matches source ordinary-medium scope. Rejection n=0 is correct (reciprocal undefined, outside profile); missing-n rejection is correct (no material-label default). Inverse n=299792458/v verified: single positive root with c fixed; v=149896229 gives exactly n=2 and forward substitution returns 149896229; vacuum v=c gives n=1; v=0 has no finite index; v>c leaves the declared profile with an explicit non-universal disclaimer. No causal invertibility over-claim.

reference-independence.evidence: Passed: independently recomputed. Zircon: 299792458/1.923=155898314.09 vs expected 156000000, diff 101685.9 within tolerance 500000 and within half the source 1e6 output increment; source rounded-c route 3.00e8/1.923=156006240.25 confirms published 1.56e8. Vacuum: n=1 gives exactly 299792458 within 1e-6 float allowance. Inverse spot checks exact (299792458/149896229=2; /2=149896229). Published oracle vs same-equation reproduction properly distinguished in record methods.

scope.evidence: Passed: scope is the source ordinary-transparent-media profile (real n>=1 plus vacuum boundary), with wavelength/state dependence explicit (589 nm vacuum wavelength, Table 1.1 material-state conditions as reference data, not defaults). Limitations exclude anomalous-dispersion, plasma, complex-index and metamaterial phase velocities and bar pulse/group/signal-speed use. 'Phase' meaning (monochromatic phase speed/index vs group or signal) is explicit and survives as a binding constraint.

source-fidelity.evidence: Passed: original n=c/v matches Eq. 1.2; solved v=c/n matches Example 1.1 strategy/solution; Eq. 1.1 c=2.99792458e8 approx 3.00e8 confirmed; Table 1.1 zircon n=1.923 at 589 nm vacuum wavelength and Example 1.1 v=1.56e8 confirmed; source n>=1 prose confirmed; exact c=299792458 m/s as SI defining value confirmed on NIST page. Registry-constant attribution (value/dimensions, not repeated in constants metadata) is coherent and NIST-attributed.

models.permitted_use: Compute monochromatic phase speed v=speed_of_light/n only for ordinary transparent homogeneous media with real supplied n>=1 at the matched optical state (frequency/vacuum wavelength, mode, composition/phase, temperature, pressure, medium rest frame), including vacuum n=1; requires a runtime resolving speed_of_light to exactly 299792458 m/s. Not for group/signal/pulse travel time, dispersive/anomalous/plasma/metamaterial regimes, or as empirical index data. Redistribution subject to OpenStax CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus asserted AI-use/commercial permission terms and NIST attribution terms; owner rights review required before commercial or AI-training use.
